embeds.description:
**Actor:** Adam Young, Harrison Gevirtz, India-based telemarketing fraudsters, four Indian nationals, one American
Adam Young, 42, and Harrison Gevirtz, 33, pleaded guilty to misprision of a felony for providing phone numbers, call routing services, call tracking tools and call forwarding services to India-based telemarketing fraudsters through their U.S.-based tech firm C.A. Cloud Attribution from 2016 to 2022. The scheme targeted elderly and disabled Americans with fake pop-up messages, routing victims to call centers in India where scammers stole millions of dollars and remotely accessed victim devices to steal financial information. Young and Gevirtz also owned a call center in Tunisia and continued providing services after learning of fraud in 2017, advising scammers on detection avoidance techniques.
